summary.name: Google Vids
summary.one_liner: Google Vids is a browser-based, AI-assisted video creation and editing tool within Google Workspace for building and sharing videos with Gemini.
use_cases: Creating work presentations and explainer videos
Turning Google Slides presentations into video
Generating video clips or avatar presenters without a camera
Translating and voicing video content in 24 languages
Recording screen and narration for tutorials
Collaborating on team video projects and sharing with permissions
summary.what_it_does: Google Vids lets users create videos from templates, stock media, or Google Slides presentations, and record screen and audio directly. Gemini-powered features can generate video clips, music, AI avatars, and voiceovers, and animate uploaded images with native audio. Editing works by changing a text transcript like a document, followed by captions and transitions. Videos can be shared with granular edit, comment, or view permissions, viewed in a browser with auto-generated captions, and exported directly to YouTube as private by default.
notable: Edit video by editing the text transcript like a document
AI generation of clips, avatars, voiceovers in 24 languages
Direct export to YouTube, defaulting to private
Integrates with Google Slides and Workspace collaboration
caveats: Advanced features and expanded usage limits require business or consumer paid plans
Video creation and editing only on desktop; viewing works on desktop and mobile
Each video is capped at 30 minutes
